answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The island holds work receipts rather than names, so the quill of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
